name: Tier pricing table
summary: Unit price per quantity tier, for bulk orders. The row that matches the current quantity is marked.
use: Product page for bulk orders, above or next to Add to cart.
Anywhere the price each depends on the quantity.
avoid: Comparing plans or products: use a Table.
The total of the order: show that next to the buy button or in Cart summary.
anatomy: Optional title, with an "Indicative" badge when prices are an estimate.
Table: quantity, price each and optionally the saving compared to the first tier.
Active row: tinted, a line on the left and bold text. The saving is green on a normal row and takes the text color on the active row, for contrast.
Optional line below: the VAT text and a footnote.
figmaProps: Shows or hides the Saving column.
Show rows 5 to 8 in the layers panel. On a row: State (Default, Hover, Active, Focus), Selectable, Quantity, Price, Saving, Has saving.
reactProps: 2 to 8 tiers. A tier ends where the next one starts, so there is no max.
The matching row is marked. Below the first tier no row is marked.
Makes the quantity of each row a button. Set your quantity to tier.min.
Shows "Prices excl. VAT" or "Prices incl. VAT" once, below the table.
As in Price. Use decimals 3 for unit prices such as €0.523.
Default true. The saving is a rounded percentage compared to the first tier.
Column names, the range text, the hidden texts and the hint. Defaults in DEFAULT_TIER_PRICING_LABELS.
Hook for the page. hint is a ready-made text such as "Add 200 more and pay €0.480 each": pass it to quantityHint of Add to cart.
behaviour: The active row follows the quantity. Keep the quantity in the page and give it to both this table and Add to cart.
With onTierSelect a click on a quantity sets the quantity to the start of that tier. The whole first cell is the click target.
The hint to the next tier is not in the table. It belongs next to the quantity, where the customer acts: use useTierPricing and quantityHint.
The tiers are sorted by quantity, whatever order you give them in.
a11y: A real table with column headers, so a screen reader reads "Price each" with every price.
The active row has aria-current and the hidden text "Your price". Color is not the only signal: there is a line on the left and bold text.
When the tier changes, the new price is read out (status).
A row button is named after its range and what it does: "250 – 499 set quantity to 250".
content: Title: say what the table is. "Volume prices".
Use the footnote for what the price includes: "Including one print position".
do: Use the same decimals as in Price on the same page.
Show the VAT text once, below the table.
dont: A second hint in the page that says the same as the active row.
open: Not built: a horizontal layout with chips, a total per row and an error state. Use Alert when prices cannot be loaded.
Assumption: the saving is calculated as a rounded percentage. A shop cannot give its own saving text per tier.
Assumption: below the first tier no row is marked. The message about the minimum comes from Quantity stepper.
Without the Saving column there is a lot of space between quantity and price in a wide container. Give the table a narrow column.
Not tested with a screen reader.
